item.title: Show HN: An RSS Feed for DeepSWE Benchmarks
item.summary: Hi. I check DeepSWE website ( https://deepswe.datacurve.ai/ ) regularly because their benchmark results make sense. They however do not offer an RSS feed, only an email newsletter. I decided to create one for my own reader, which is free for everyone else as well, as is always(?) the case for RSS: https://rss.xlit.app/deepswe Feel free to use. Thanks.
